## Summary

Implements **P17.1 — Private-camera federation and RTCC integration** (`docs/tickets/P17.1__broader-federation-rtcc.md`, spec §5.2 / §11 / §12.3 / §12.4 / §13.1 / Appendix D.5). Phase 17 is the **standing proof of §5.2**: the schema frozen in Phase 2/4 must absorb a Stage-5 technology span **with no change**. This PR *populates* the three Appendix D.5 pathways as instance graphs over the generated Pydantic model, extending the generalization conformance suite. **Additive and test-only** — no LinkML source, generated artifact, or wire contract changed; `verify-gen` is byte-clean.

The whole ticket resolves to a population + conformance proof because the committed §12/§13 schema already expresses every construct: `RoleAssignment` (owner/operator), `IntegrationEdge` (`enrolls_asset_into`/`ingests_feed_from`/`federates_search_to`/`pushes_alerts_to`), `AccessRelationship` (`subscribes_to`/`resells_data_from`), `DataSystem`, `PhysicalAsset`, and every §13.1 vocabulary slug the pathways name.

## What changed

- `tests/ontology/generalization/test_stage5_federation.py` (new, 12 tests) — the populated Stage-5 pathways and their assertions.
- `docs/traceability.md` — new **P17.1** section mapping every stamped requirement to its test.
- `docs/risk_register.md` — new **Phase 17 — P17.1** section: the Phase-1-defect record path (RISK-P17-01), out-of-scope deferrals (RISK-P17-02/03), and one modelling observation (RISK-P17-04).

## Design decisions

- **Populate, don't schema-change.** The pathways are instance graphs over the *committed* Pydantic model and vocabulary. `test_stage5_population_required_no_schema_change` asserts every edge type, role, entity class, and §13.1 slug the pathways use already exists — so a construct that ever needed a new element would fail the suite, and that red result **is** the recorded Phase-1 defect (filed against P01.1, never patched here). No such defect was found.
- **No ADR** — an ADR records a *deviation*, and there is none (no schema/wire change).
- **Registry ≠ integration.** The vocabulary's `private-camera-registry` ("no live feed access") vs `private-camera-integration` ("live private feeds") cleanly carries the ticket's requirement that `enrolls_asset_into` (a device fact) stay distinct from a live-feed fact with its own `consent_gate`.
- **Six-layer broker chain** modelled from the verified R7 F7.29 structure (App publisher/SDK → ad exchange/bid-stream → aggregating broker → productizer/UI vendor → investigative-platform host → agency), with `resells_data_from` between the *separate* aggregator and productizer orgs — the layer the outline's five-step diagram collapses.

## Deviations / deferrals

- **Out of scope, confirmed not implemented:** facial recognition, cell-site simulators, mobile-device forensics, federal authorization datasets (**P17.2**); gunshot detection, drones, commercial location-data ingestion (**P17.3**); any schema/ontology change (owned by P01.1). See RISK-P17-02.
- **Population is expressibility, not ingestion** — the pathways are conformance-suite instance graphs, not claim-spine rows; live population arrives with the Stage-5 connectors over the same frozen schema (RISK-P17-03).
- **Modelling observation (not a defect):** `RoleAssignment` inherits a role-orthogonal `edge_type` from `Edge`; the separation is still fully representable via `role`/`party`/`over`. Recorded as RISK-P17-04 for P01.1.
